verdict.rationale: Braintrust's API docs say the API lets you "interact with all aspects of the Braintrust platform programmatically," and list projects, experiments, datasets, traces, prompts, tools and scorers. The bt CLI, SDKs and official MCP server back this up by covering logs, evals, scorers, Topics and monitoring outside the UI. Parity is asserted by the vendor and not independently verified, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at common paths. Missing for 10: documented API coverage for Playgrounds, Patterns, annotation interfaces and dashboards; a discoverable OpenAPI spec; independent or hands-on confirmation of full UI parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Braintrust API allows you to interact with all aspects of the Braintrust platform programmatically.
Create and manage projects, experiments, and datasets; Log traces and metrics; Manage prompts, tools, and scorers
Run them from code or in the UI
Query logs, author scorers, configure Topics, and run evals from your editor.
It lets you authenticate, trace coding-agent sessions, run evals, browse and query logs, sync data, and manage functions without leaving your terminal.
